Tests that Performance and PerformanceEntry toJSON() serialization is side-effect-free.
Expression `performance.toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `performance.timing.toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `performance.navigation.toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(performance)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(performance.getEntries())`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0].toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `performance.getEntriesByName('test-mark')[0].toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(performance.getEntriesByName('test-mark'))`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `performance.mark('blocked')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `performance.clearResourceTimings()`
has side effect: true, expected: true
